panels.description: Cinza = sem cliente considerado. Verde = normal. Ponto LARANJA (maior, sobreposto) = CTO/prédio atenuado (100% dos logins com sinal <= -27 dBm). Pontos VERMELHOS GRANDES com rótulo = queda recente confirmada (2+ clientes desconectados nas últimas 48h e 50%+ do ponto afetado). Inclui CTOs externas e clientes em prédios/condomínios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT local_nome, bairro, latitude, longitude, total_clientes, offline, status_val FROM ( SELECT local_nome, bairro, latitude, longitude, total_clientes, offline, atenuados, total_logins, min_sinal, pct, pon_list, olt_list, status_val FROM ( SELECT cx.descricao AS local_nome, cx.bairro AS bairro, CAST(cx.latitude AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS latitude, CAST(cx.longitude AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS longitude, COALESCE(l.total,0) AS total_clientes, COALESCE(l.offline,0) AS offline, COALESCE(l.atenuados,0) AS atenuados, COALESCE(l.total_logins,0) AS total_logins, l.min_sinal AS min_sinal, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0*l.offline/l.total,1) END AS pct, l.pon_list AS pon_list, l.olt_list AS olt_list, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total,0)=0 THEN -1 WHEN l.offline>=2 AND (100.0*l.offline/l.total)>=50 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(l.total_logins,0)>=2 AND l.atenuados=l.total_logins THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status_val FROM rad_caixa_ftth cx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT logins.id_caixa_ftth, COUNT(*) AS total_logins, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.open_session=1 OR (ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sinal_rx <= -27 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS atenuados, MIN(f.sinal_rx) AS min_sinal, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ((ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) OR f.sinal_rx <= -27 THEN f.ponid END ORDER BY f.ponid SEPARATOR ', ') AS pon_list, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ((ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sinal_rx <= -27 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS atenuados, MIN(f.sinal_rx) AS min_sinal, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ((ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) OR f.sinal_rx <= -27 THEN f.ponid END ORDER BY f.ponid SEPARATOR ', ') AS pon_list, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ((ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) OR f.sinal_rx <= -27 THEN f.olt_desc END ORDER BY f.olt_desc SEPARATOR ', ') AS olt_list FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.id, ru.login, ru.id_predio FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A' AND ru.id_predio IS NOT NULL AND ru.id_predio<>0) logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login LEFT JOIN (SELECT rf.id_login, rf.ponid, rf.sinal_rx, rr.descricao AS olt_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rf.id_login ORDER BY rf.ultima_atualizacao DESC, rf.id DESC) AS rn FROM radpop_radio_cliente_fibra rf LEFT JOIN radpop_radio rr ON rr.id = rf.id_transmissor WHERE rf.id_login > 0) f ON f.id_login = logins.id AND f.rn = 1 GROUP BY logins.id_predio ) p ON p.id_predio = pr.id WHERE pr.status = 'A' AND pr.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pr.latitude <> '' ) u ) x WHERE total_clientes >= 2

INTERVAL 2 DAY) OR f.sinal_rx <= -27 THEN f.olt_desc END ORDER BY f.olt_desc SEPARATOR ', ') AS olt_list FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.id, ru.login, ru.id_predio FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A' AND ru.id_predio IS NOT NULL AND ru.id_predio<>0) logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login LEFT JOIN (SELECT rf.id_login, rf.ponid, rf.sinal_rx, rr.descricao AS olt_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rf.id_login ORDER BY rf.ultima_atualizacao DESC, rf.id DESC) AS rn FROM radpop_radio_cliente_fibra rf LEFT JOIN radpop_radio rr ON rr.id = rf.id_transmissor WHERE rf.id_login > 0) f ON f.id_login = logins.id AND f.rn = 1 GROUP BY logins.id_predio ) p ON p.id_predio = pr.id WHERE pr.status = 'A' AND pr.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pr.latitude <> '' ) u ) x WHERE status_val IN (1, 2) ORDER BY status_val DESC, `% Offline` DESC, `Sinal Min (dBm)` ASC
